title: Explicit unsigned pairing on Cech rows
statement: Let X be a scheme, U any indexed family of opens, and D a CupResolutionPairing of F and G [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data]. For resolution degrees r,s and Cech degrees i,j, define a function from C^i(U,D.left.K^r) × C^j(U,D.right.K^s) to C^(i+j)(U,D.target.K^(r+s)) [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data]. At a tuple y, restrict the first cochain on its front i-face and the second on its back j-face [def-sc-cech-cup-product], and apply D.pair r s on the common intersection. This is an explicit tuplewise construction, with no chosen witness or postponed data.
